messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposal to add latency guardrails per-customer tier + automatic model-variant handoff when the CB trips. idea: targets at p50/p95, availability floor, and CB thresholds that trigger a fallback to smaller quantized variant or regional reroute. thoughts?

alex: sounds solid. can you sketch the signals? p95 alone feels brittle. also need in-flight queue length / headway.

maria: agreed. initial signals: p95 latency, error rate (5xx%), and queue depth. CB trips when 2/3 signals exceed thresholds for 30s. fallback order: same-region compatible variant -> lower-precision variant -> different-region replica.

sanjay: what about tier differences? free vs standard vs enterprise?

maria: free: looser latency SLA, aggressive fallback earlier. standard: balanced. enterprise: high availability, prefer cross-region failover only after variant fallback. thresholds are per-tier configs.

jen: UX q: console should show the active policy, last CB event, and quick rollback. Can we surface a tiny timeline + reason (latency spike / errors / capacity)?

kevin: from API side we need a small routing-decider contract: input = { tenant, tier, region_hint, model_id, seq_len_est } -> output = { route_to: variant_id, reason_code, cb_state }. should be synchronous (<10ms).

alex: debate: sync decider is easier for correctness but increases tail. alternative: async prefetcher that suggests routes and fallback order, while per-request fast lookup uses cached policy.

sanjay: oncall prefers sync with cache TTL 200ms and local fast path, so we can immediately evaluate CB state without cross-network hop.

maria: telemetry needs: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, cb_events (count + duration), fallback_counts by variant, region_migrations, rejected_requests. store sample traces for regressions.

jen: console: add a per-tenant panel with those metrics + playback. also a "Simulate tier incident" button to preview policy behavior (no-op unless dev org).

kevin: config proto sketch (KISS):
```yaml
policy_version: v1
tiers:
  free:
    p95_target_ms: 800
    cb_thresholds:
      p95_ms: 1200
      error_rate_pct: 3
      queue_depth: 100
    fallback_order: [quantized-1, regional-replica]
  standard:
    p95_target_ms: 350
    cb_thresholds:
      p95_ms: 700
      error_rate_pct: 1
      queue_depth: 50
    fallback_order: [quantized-2, same-region-variant, regional-replica]
  enterprise:
    p95_target_ms: 150
    cb_thresholds:
      p95_ms: 300
      error_rate_pct: 0.5
      queue_depth: 20
    fallback_order: [same-region-variant, regional-replica, quantized-2]
```

alex: need to include model-artifacts compatibility matrix for variant handoff (vocab/ops). fallback should only pick compatible variants.

maria: yep — routing-decider must validate compatibility. if no compatible variant, do region failover or reject with graceful degrade response.

routing-bot: deploy: policy/v1 config updated for staging -> rolling to canary (3 pods). :rocket:

jen: one more UX ask: in rollout flow, allow canary to override fallback order for experimentation. add a small experiment toggle with metrics gated.

kevin: impl note: store CB state in local LRU + central aggregator. CB decisions use local state first, fall back to central if stale. instrument both.

sanjay: SLO monitoring: alert if enterprise p95 > target for 10m with >5% tenants affected. also alert on unusual fallback spikes.

maria: action items: 1) kevin to draft API contract + proto (this week) 2) alex to write compatibility matrix extractor 3) jen to prototype console panel + simulate button 4) sanjay to define alert thresholds 5) maria to draft rollout playbook (canary -> gradual -> global).

kevin: I'll add the API PR and a simple simulator service for experiments.

alex: I'll start extracting variant metadata and a small tool to verify compatibility.

jen: will mock the UI in Figma and link.

maria: thanks everyone. sync Friday 11am to review proto + mocks. :thumbsup:
